summary_1line: Agastya explains the origins of Bali and Sugriva, then begins a legend where Ravana questions Sanatkumara about the supreme deity Narayana.

image_candidates.scene_text: The celestial messenger installs Riksharajas as king in the jeweled city of Kishkindha while vanaras gather around him.
Ravana stands with folded hands before the radiant sage Sanatkumara seated in a luminous forest hermitage.
